overview_description.description: Paladin is the largest independent manufacturer of performance-driven coupler systems and attachment tools for carriers, from small compact tool carriers to large excavators, wheel loaders, tractors and truck chassis. It brings together eight industry-leading brands with more than 200 years of combined experience to offer hundreds of innovative products for all makes and models.

about_short_description.short_description: Paladin Attachments is one of the largest independent manufacturers of coupler systems and attachment tools for tractors & truck chassis.

product.name: Backhoe Attachments
product.description: Attachment tools designed for backhoe machines to perform digging, trenching, and material handling tasks.

product.name: Coupler Systems
product.description: Coupler systems connect compatible attachments to compact and heavy equipment, including backhoes and excavators.

product.name: Dozer Attachments
product.description: Tools and attachments for dozer machines used in earthmoving, grading, and land clearing operations.

product.name: Sweeper and Broom Attachments
product.description: Sweeper and broom attachments remove debris and surface materials from roads, worksites, airports, and other managed areas.

product.name: Harley MX Series Power Rakes
product.description: Power rakes prepare and grade soil and other ground surfaces for landscaping, construction, and land management work.

product.name: Excavator Attachments
product.description: Attachments for excavators that support digging, demolition, material handling, and forestry tasks.
